description_preview:
Overview
Job Purpose
We are seeking a Software Developer to join our innovative development team. In this role, you will contribute to the design and development of our applications while taking ownership of specific components and features.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain web applications using Java and Spring Boot for backend services and React for frontend development
Implement new features and enhancements to existing functionality with moderate guidance
Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code following best practices and team standards
Create and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate them with React-based frontends
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues in both backend and frontend systems
Participate in code reviews, providing and receiving constructive feedback
Write and maintain unit tests to ensure code quality and functionality
Contribute to database design and development using SQL and PostgreSQL
Stay current with relevant technologies and frameworks
Provide occasional guidance to junior developers
Knowledge And Experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
3+ years of professional software development experience
Java Programming: Deep knowledge of Java language, its ecosystem, and best practices
Experience with SQL, PostgreSQL and relational database concepts
Frontend Technologies: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and TypeScript
Backend Development: Expertise in developing and maintaining backend services using Java, Spring, and related technologies
Strong understanding of RESTful services, microservices architecture, and database management
Familiarity with version control systems like Git, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD pipelines
AI & ML Fundamentals: Understanding of natural language processing (NLP), machine learning concepts, and how LLMs work
Prompt Frameworks & Techniques: Proficiency in methods such as zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, and knowledge-generation prompting
LLM API Experience: Hands-on work with major AI platforms (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini) to test and refine prompts
Prompt Optimization: Ability to craft precise, structured instructions that reduce hallucinations and improve accuracy
Data Preparation: Preparing and curating datasets for training or fine-tuning models
Performance Analysis: Measuring and improving AI output quality through A/B testing and iterative refinement
Preferred Experience
Knowledge of cloud platforms (OCP, Apigee, AWS, GCP, or Azure)
Experience with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions)
Knowledge of containerization concepts (Docker)
Familiarity with microservices architecture
Experience with automated testing frameworks
Understanding of responsive design and accessibility standards
Knowledge of performance optimization techniques

title: 🚀 Hiring: Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps & Security Engineers — Entry-Level Opportunities for Emerging Talent
reason: Stack +62; Synergy +8; Title fit +6; Entry +15; US +10
description_preview:
About the Role
We are looking for enthusiastic recent Master's graduates to kickstart their careers as Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps, and Security Engineers. This is a great opportunity for freshers to gain hands-on experience with real-world cloud systems, security practices, and automation pipelines while working alongside experienced mentors. Experienced professionals are welcome too, but we especially encourage recent graduates to apply.
Eligibility
Master's Degree (M.Tech, MCA, M.S., M.E., or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cloud Computing, Cyber Security, or a related field — recent graduates strongly encouraged to apply.
No prior work experience required for entry-level roles; academic projects, internships, or certifications are a big plus.
Passion for learning cloud technologies, security fundamentals, and modern DevOps tools.
Responsibilities
Assist in designing, building, and maintaining cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, or GCP under senior guidance.
Support development and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment.
Learn and apply Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.
Help implement basic security measures like IAM policies, network configurations, and encryption practices.
Monitor system performance and assist in identifying and resolving vulnerabilities.
Get hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes.
Participate in code reviews, security audits, and team knowledge-sharing sessions.
Continuously learn and grow with mentorship from senior engineers.
Required Skills
Foundational understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) gained through coursework or personal projects.
Basic scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
Familiarity with Git and version control concepts.
Understanding of networking fundamentals and operating systems (Linux/Windows).
Eagerness to learn CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving attitude, and willingness to learn.
Preferred Skills (Good to Have)
Academic exposure to cloud certifications (AWS Cloud Practitioner, Azure Fundamentals) or coursework projects.
Basic knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes concepts.
Understanding of cyber security fundamentals (CEH, Security+ coursework or certification is a plus).
Familiarity with DevOps concepts and automation tools.
Personal projects, GitHub contributions, or hackathon experience.
Who Should Apply
Recent Master's graduates looking to start their career in Cloud, DevOps, or Security.
Students who completed internships or capstone projects in cloud/security domains.
Anyone passionate about building a career in cloud infrastructure and security engineering.
📩 Interested candidates are requested to send their updated resume for consideration.

description_preview:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
As an AMD intern or co-op, you’ll be placed at the epicenter of the AI ecosystem, working alongside experts and industry pioneers. You’ll do important work, learn new skills, expand your network, and gain real-world experience on projects that impact millions of end-users worldwide. Whether you’re an undergrad or a PhD student, your contributions matter—and your experience here will be a launchpad for what comes next.
Job Details
Locations: Austin, TX, Boxborough, MA, Fort Collins, CO, Longmont, CO, Fishkill, NY, Rochester, NY
Onsite/Hybrid: This role requires the student to work full time (40 hours a week), in either a hybrid or onsite work structure throughout the duration of the co-op/intern term
Duration
Spring/Summer Co-op: January 15, 2027 - August 13, 2027
Summer Internship:
Semester Students: May 24, 2027 - August 13, 2027
Quarter Students: June 21, 2027 - September 10, 2027
Summer/Fall Co-op:
Semester Students: May 24, 2027 - December 10, 2027
Quarter Students: June 21, 2027 - December 10, 2027
What You Will Be Doing
We are seeking highly motivated Software Engineering co-op to join our team at AMD. In this role –
We will assign you responsibilities in which you will work closely with our software engineers to build and maintain our software applications.
We will provide training on the full software creation process, from design and built to testing and deployment.
We will encourage you to build scripts that automate some of our software development process.
We will help you learn debugging methodologies to investigate the root cause of software issues.
In certain projects we may have your involvement in crafting technical/functional documents and reports as needed.
Who We Are Looking For
Currently enrolled in a US based University in a Undergrad degree program majoring in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or related discipline
If you have knowledge / experience with any of the following technical skills (or related areas) and are enthusiastic about this role, we strongly encourage you to apply –
Software engineering concepts, principles, and theories
C/C++ programming and Scripting language like Python, Windows PowerShell, Linux shell script, Perl, Java, Javascript, UML
Operating systems UNIX/Linux OS
Databases, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
Cloud computing platforms, Azure.
Web development frameworks, Django, Rails, Spring Boot
Mark up languages like HTML, XML, XSL
Defect tracking, testing, debugging
Git, Github, Perforce
Security technologies, OAuth, SSL, or TLS
PC / CPU architecture, Embedded systems, microcontroller

By submitting your application, you are indicating your interest in AMD intern positions. We are recruiting for multiple positions, and if your experience aligns with any of our intern opportunities, a recruiter will contact you.

ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

Whether you’re an undergrad or a PhD student, your contributions matter—and your experience here will be a launchpad for what comes next.
Job Details
Locations: Austin, TX, Boxborough, MA, Fort Collins, CO, Longmont, CO, Fishkill, NY, Rochester, NY, Secaucus, NJ
Onsite/Hybrid: This role requires the student to work full time (40 hours a week), in either a hybrid or onsite work structure throughout the duration of the co-op/intern term
Duration:
Spring/Summer Co-op: January 15, 2027 - August 13, 2027
Summer Internship:
Semester Students: May 24, 2027 - August 13, 2027
Quarter Students: June 21, 2027 - September 10, 2027
Summer/Fall Co-op:
Semester Students: May 24, 2027 - December 10, 2027
Quarter Students: June 21, 2027 - December 10, 2027
What You Will Be Doing
We are seeking highly motivated Firmware Engineering intern/co-op to join our team and work with team members in the support, design, development, and delivery of Firmware for AMD’s discrete and embedded products. In this role –
We will assign you responsibilities to craft, implement, debug, and validate features on reference hardware and software, pre-silicon emulation and simulation environments supporting AMD products
We will encourage to actively participate in design reviews, code reviews and project planning
We will train you to build and complete clear documentation for all software produced
We will provide opportunities to work on both internal and external platforms
We will help you learn and apply AGILE methodologies and standard processes for Software Engineering
You may be involved in one or more (but not limited to) of the following work -
Engage in x86 firmware development using C
Design, Build and Implementation of Embedded Firmware + Bootrom/HW
Debug issues at the boundary of FW and HW. We will have your involvement in Waveform level analysis to root cause FW/HW issues
Who We Are Looking For
You are currently enrolled in a US based University in a Bachelor’s program majoring in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field
If you have knowledge or experience with any of the following technical skills (or related areas) and are enthusiastic about this role, we strongly encourage you to apply –
Low level BIOS, firmware, or system software development
Low level programming language C/C++ and knowledge of hardware architectures
Embedded system, RTOS, and embedded controller structure
Source control, debuggers, compilers and system wide debugging from software to firmware to hardware
Opensource concepts
VHDL/Verilog/FPGA and general hardware design concepts and process
Linux development environments
Architectural understanding and/or experience of graphics/compute pipelines
Perforce, JIRA, Git, or similar tools

title: Software Quality Engineer I - III (DOE)
reason: Title disqualified: Software Quality Engineer I - III (DOE)
reject_reason: Title disqualified: Software Quality Engineer I - III (DOE)
description_preview:
Software Quality Engineer I – III (DOE)
Hybrid role (3 days/week in office) at our Burlington, Renton, Spokane, Vancouver, Portland, Medford, Salt Lake City, Boise, Lewiston, or Fargo offices.
Candidates must reside within commutable distance of that location or be willing to relocate.
Build a career with purpose. Join our
Cause
to create a person-focused and economically sustainable health care system.
Who We Are Looking For
Every day, Cambia’s dedicated team of Software Quality Engineers are living our mission to make health care easier and lives better. As a member of the Software Quality Engineering team, our Software Quality Engineers are responsible for assuring the delivery of high quality products and software services. The Software Quality Engineer I works with teammates to prevent and detect defects throughout the product lifecycle, evaluate the appropriateness of software solutions for customers and the enterprise, and enable delivery team productivity. The Software Quality Engineer II applies a wide variety for testing and quality assurance techniques to complex software projects often requiring coordination with multiple software delivery teams. The Software Quality Engineer III is a senior level engineer that applies extensive technical knowledge and experience to develop and deliver solutions for software projects.
Do you thrive as a part of a collaborative, caring team? Then this role may be the perfect fit.
Qualifications
What You Bring to Cambia:
The
Software Quality Engineer I
would have a BA/BS degree in computer science or related field and relevant experience in one programming language, such as Java, Ruby, Python or C# or equivalent combination of education and experience.
The
Software Quality Engineer II
would have a BA/BS degree in computer science or related field and 3 years of experience performing software quality and testing throughout product development, deployment and maintenance and 1 year of experience writing, running and automating tests; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
The
Software Quality Engineer III
would have a BA/BS degree in computer science or related field and 6 years of experience performing software quality and testing throughout product development, deployment and maintenance, including 3 years of experience writing, running and automating tests; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Skills And Attributes
Demonstrated proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Java, Ruby, Python or C#.
Ability to react quickly and remain productive in a fast-paced work environment.
Ability to learn, apply and follow company best practices.
Ability to work independently, raise issues and take corrective action.
Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical project team members.
Demonstrated experience with web, mobile and database application technologies, automated testing and tools.
Demonstrated experience with one or more: software reliability, automated test maintenance, static analysis, or code coverage.
Demonstrated ability to apply appropriate industry-standard processes and practices to prevent and detect defects throughout the software development lifecycle.
Demonstrated ability to utilize metrics and understand processes related to effective quality assurance and testing progress.
Extensive experience with web, mobile and database application technologies, automated testing, frameworks and tools.
Demonstrated experience with TDD/ATDD, Continuous Integration, Design for Testability, and Software Stability.
Demonstrated ability to select appropriate industry-standard processes and practices to prevent and detect defects throughout the software development lifecycle.
Demonstrated ability to work across project teams to leverage existing knowledge, technologies and solutions.
What You Will Do At Cambia
Participate on project scrum team and defect triage team while managing personal work backlog using agile practices
Review user stories, acceptance criteria, specifications, software designs, code and tests to ensure quality standards
Develop, automate and execute unit, component and system-level tests using industry-standard methods; write automated and manual test cases while collaborating with peers to ensure adequate coverage
Report test results, submit defects, verify fixes, and assess impact of requirements/design/code changes to recommend test updates and regression testing
Ensure software testability, test coverage and maintainability meet project requirements; mentor team members on achieving required coverage and improving automated test stability
Collaborate with Development to define requirements, design and implementation ensuring testability, scalability, maintainability, and reliability Develop technical solutions to meet project quality, cost and schedule requirements while mitigating risks and ensuring executable quality and test plans
Use metrics to drive process effectiveness, monitor testing progress and product quality, and lead assigned process improvement efforts
Collaborate on integration and system-level tests; escalate issues to Software Quality Lead as needed
Pay ranges vary based on the candidate's work location. The expected hiring range depends on skills, experience, education, and training; relevant licensure / certifications; and performance history.
Software Quality Engineer I
Oregon, Washington, Utah, and Idaho: The expected hiring range is $72,000 - $90,000, the full salary range is $72,000- $117,000, and the bonus target is 10%.
North Dakota: The expected hiring range is $60,000 - $77,000, and the full salary range is $60,000 - $95,000.
Software Quality Engineer II
Oregon, Washington, Utah, and Idaho: The expected hiring range is $79,000 - $99,000, the full salary range is $79,000- $129,000, and the bonus target is 10%.
North Dakota: The expected hiring range is $66,000 - $86,000, and the full salary range is $66,000 - $106,000.

Standard Job Description
Plans, conducts, and coordinates software development activities. Designs, develops, documents, tests, and debugs software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to business/mission problems or questions in computer language for solutions by means of data processing equipment. Applies the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the development life cycle. Applies knowledge of computer hardware and software, subject matter to be programmed in business/mission applications, information processing techniques used, and information gathered from system users to develop software. Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles documentation of program development, and analyzes system capabilities to resolve questions of program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques, and controls. Ensures software standards are met.
Who We Are
The ISR UAS division of Lockheed Martin Skunk Works is seeking world class software engineers to join a team that continues our 80‑year legacy of pioneering advanced aircraft. Our Mission Processing engineers design, develop, and integrate software that powers the flight control, navigation, sensor-fusion, and communications subsystems of cutting‑edge unmanned aircraft. We operate in a highly innovative, multi‑site environment where speed, modularity, and reusability are paramount.
What You'll Do
You will support the development and maintenance of platform‑level software for ISR and UAS systems. In this role you will build and maintain deployable system images and runtime environments, bundling operating‑system components, middleware, and platform services into validated volumes. You will collaborate closely with software, systems, and security teams to ensure the infrastructure is reliable, repeatable, and secure, and you will provide ongoing troubleshooting and enhancements that keep the platform stable and ready for rapid field deployment.
What’s In It For You
Working directly with middleware and platform‑level infrastructure will give you hands‑on technical experience and deep expertise in the core software that powers ISR and UAS missions. You’ll participate in system configuration, service integration, and image creation activities, expanding your knowledge across the entire software lifecycle. Daily collaboration with seasoned engineers from software, integration, and test teams provides mentorship that accelerates your professional growth, while your contributions will directly impact the reliability and agility of cutting edge unmanned systems supporting critical missions. This high visibility work also builds a strong portfolio that prepares you for future roles within the organization and the wider engineering community.
YOUR IMPACT
By supporting Mission Processing software, you create the reliable foundation that enables ISR and UAS systems to execute complex missions. Your work keeps the underlying software stable, repeatable, and secure, reducing integration risk and accelerating development and testing cycles, which in turn speeds the delivery of next‑generation capabilities to the field.
Key Responsibilities
Support development and maintenance of deployable system images
Assist with integrating middleware and system services into runtime volumes
Support configuration management and system initialization tasks
Develop and maintain scripts to assist with image creation and validation
Support integration and deployment activities in lab and test environments
Participate in peer code reviews and technical discussions
Travel up to 10% may be required.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent experience)
Experience with the software development process in a team environment (peer reviews, unit testing, configuration management, defect tracking)
Experience in C++, Bash shell, or Python
Experience with Linux operating systems (Red Hat preferred)
Familiarity with GitLab CI/CD pipelines for automated builds, tests, and deployments
Must be a US Citizen. This position is located at a facility that requires special access and a Secret clearance updated within the last 5 years to be considered.
Desired Skills
Experience building and debugging applications in Linux based development environments
Exposure to build environments and tools such as Make and CMake
Exposure to hardware and software integration
Exposure to scripting, automation, or build tooling
Exposure to version control systems and team‑based development workflows
Familiarity with Agile workflow tools and collaborative version‑control practices (Git, JIRA, Confluence, etc.)
Willingness to learn and work in complex software environments
Current Security+ certification or the ability to obtain it

The Software Quality Engineer I works with teammates to prevent and detect defects throughout the product lifecycle, evaluate the appropriateness of software solutions for customers and the enterprise, and enable delivery team productivity. would have a BA/BS degree in computer science or related field and relevant experience in one programming language, such as Java, Ruby, Python or C# or equivalent combination of education and experience.

The

would have a BA/BS degree in computer science or related field and 6 years of experience performing software quality and testing throughout product development, deployment and maintenance, including 3 years of experience writing, running and automating tests; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Skills And Attributes
Demonstrated proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Java, Ruby, Python or C#.
Ability to react quickly and remain productive in a fast-paced work environment.
Ability to learn, apply and follow company best practices.
Ability to work independently, raise issues and take corrective action.
Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical project team members.
Demonstrated experience with web, mobile and database application technologies, automated testing and tools.
Demonstrated experience with one or more: software reliability, automated test maintenance, static analysis, or code coverage.
Demonstrated ability to apply appropriate industry-standard processes and practices to prevent and detect defects throughout the software development lifecycle.
Demonstrated ability to utilize metrics and understand processes related to effective quality assurance and testing progress.
Extensive experience with web, mobile and database application technologies, automated testing, frameworks and tools.
Demonstrated experience with TDD/ATDD, Continuous Integration, Design for Testability, and Software Stability.
Demonstrated ability to select appropriate industry-standard processes and practices to prevent and detect defects throughout the software development lifecycle.
Demonstrated ability to work across project teams to leverage existing knowledge, technologies and solutions.

Participate on project scrum team and defect triage team while managing personal work backlog using agile practices
Review user stories, acceptance criteria, specifications, software designs, code and tests to ensure quality standards
Develop, automate and execute unit, component and system-level tests using industry-standard methods; write automated and manual test cases while collaborating with peers to ensure adequate coverage
Report test results, submit defects, verify fixes, and assess impact of requirements/design/code changes to recommend test updates and regression testing
Ensure software testability, test coverage and maintainability meet project requirements; mentor team members on achieving required coverage and improving automated test stability
Collaborate with Development to define requirements, design and implementation ensuring testability, scalability, maintainability, and reliability Develop technical solutions to meet project quality, cost and schedule requirements while mitigating risks and ensuring executable quality and test plans
Use metrics to drive process effectiveness, monitor testing progress and product quality, and lead assigned process improvement efforts

description_preview:
About The Role And Team
Working at Uber means solving hard problems in a high-stakes, fast-moving environment. As a Data Analyst, you will help drive the analysis behind critical decisions related to operations, process, and optimizations. You will turn unstructured problems with lots of ambiguity into focused plans of execution, creating analytical frameworks to support new initiatives and products.
This role requires you to be a big-picture thinker and strategic partner who can move with urgency and care. You'll need to take ownership of your work, stay adaptable through constant change, and demonstrate resilience when navigating the messy reality of doing big things at scale. If you are energized by challenge and motivated by real-world impact, this is where you will grow.
Rate of Pay: $113,000 to $138,000 per Year
You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered other types of comp. You will also be eligible for various benefits. More details can be found at the following link https://www.uber.com/careers/benefits.
What You'll Do
Partner with Customer Support, Engineering, and Product teams to gather and clarify business needs for analytics and reporting related to autonomous vehicle (AV) customer support.
Lead discovery and gap analysis to assess existing analytics coverage, data availability, and reporting workflows, and identify opportunities for improvement.
Document detailed business requirements, data requirements, metric definitions, and reporting specifications for new dashboards, reports, and analytics tools.
Translate business and analytics requirements into data solution requirements, defining data structures, context, and usage to support customer support quality measurement.
Perform source-to-target data mapping to support the design and implementation of new data models and data pipelines.
Support the design and development of scalable analytics solutions by ensuring alignment between business intent and technical implementation.
Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) and data validation activities to ensure new data products meet functional requirements and established data quality standards.
Maintain and update documentation for data sources, metric definitions, reporting logic, and data lineage to support long-term scalability and maintainability.
Serve as a liaison between technical and non-technical stakeholders to align on goals, priorities, dependencies, and delivery timelines.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of data analytics infrastructure, data processes, and reporting workflows supporting autonomous vehicle customer support.
May telecommute.
Basic Qualifications
Employer will accept a Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Engineering, Analytics, or related field, and two years of experience in the job offered or in a related occupation.
Position requires two years in:
Translating complex customer support and product workflows in autonomous vehicle, ride-sharing, and delivery ecosystems into precise data, analytics, and reporting requirements to support operational and customer experience decisions;
Conducting end-to-end discovery, process mapping, and source-to-target data mapping across multiple systems to design scalable, auditable data models and analytics pipelines;
Using SQL to query, reconcile, and validate large-scale structured and semi-structured datasets, including identifying and resolving data quality issues in production analytics environments;
Performing scalable, repeatable data analysis using Python or R, to build reusable analytical frameworks;
Designing, executing, and interpreting A/B tests, simulations, or causal analyses to evaluate the impact of operational, tooling, or process changes in customer support environments;
Knowledge of autonomous vehicle technology and real-world customer support operations in transportation, ride-sharing, or food and grocery delivery environments, including service quality and operational efficiency;
Building and maintaining self-service dashboards and analytics using tools such as Tableau or Looker;
Validating, monitoring, and debugging analytics outputs in production by tracing issues across upstream data sources, transformation logic, and reporting layers.
Ready to Ride?
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

description_preview:
Description
We deliver our customers peace of mind every day by helping them protect what they value most. Our passion for placing the customer at the center of everything we do is driving a transformational shift at Liberty Mutual. Operating as a tech startup within a Fortune 100 company, we are leading a digital disruption that will redefine how people experience insurance.
At Liberty, you'll thrive in a hybrid setting that fosters in-person collaboration, innovation and growth. This approach optimizes both remote and in-person interactions, enabling you to connect and ideate with your team and deepen valuable relationships across the company, while still enjoying the flexibility of remote work for focused tasks and projects.
This role has a hybrid work schedule (2 days onsite) and we are considering candidates based in Portsmouth, NH, Boston, MA, Plano, TX, Indianapolis, IN and Columbus, OH.
You must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future.
We will not sponsor employment visas.
Candidates who will require future sponsorship, including candidates on CPT/OPT/STEMOPT who will require future sponsorship, are not eligible to apply.
Job Introduction
If you want your code to matter the moment a customer asks for a quote, this is that role. Our team builds and runs the backend services behind personal lines underwriting and pricing — the APIs and rules engines that evaluates a customer's information and turns it into a risk decision (Accept, Reject, or Pause). You'll work in Java and Spring Boot on event-driven microservices, own your services end to end from design through production support, and help modernize a platform that's actively moving from monoliths to microservices. You'll also have room to grow — mentoring teammates, shaping technical direction, and using modern AI-assisted development tooling to work more effectively.
The USRM Auto Product Tech organization is looking to fill a

Splitting your time between customer-facing technical strategy and core product engineering, you will build the SDKs and prototypes that enable developers to integrate empathetic, face-to-face AI interactions into global industries.
Location
San Francisco, USA
Why this role is remarkable
Work at the frontier of AI research with the Phoenix-4 model, building systems that let machines see, hear, and respond with human-like empathy.
Join a high-growth Series B team backed by elite investors like Sequoia and Scale VP, moving past the idea stage into massive scale.
Enjoy a unique hybrid mandate where you directly influence the product roadmap by solving high-stakes technical challenges for early enterprise adopters.
What You Will Do
Collaborate hands-on with customers to debug integrations, build high-impact proof-of-concepts, and ensure a seamless developer experience with the Tavus platform.
Engineer internal tools, SDKs, and sample applications that demonstrate the power of real-time human simulation and accelerate platform-wide adoption.
Identify recurring technical friction points in the field and translate those patterns into specific feature requirements for the core engineering and product teams.
The ideal candidate
Possesses exceptionally strong software engineering fundamentals with a deep curiosity across the entire stack, including ML inference, networking, and infrastructure.
Demonstrates a product-manager mindset, capable of identifying user patterns and advocating for platform improvements that enhance the overall developer experience.
Maintains a fierce bias toward action and a founder's mentality, taking full ownership of complex problems until they are completely resolved.
Who are Jack & Jill?
Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.
And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.
How does this work?
Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.
We never post fake jobs
This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.
Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.
We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.
